تنتهبي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِبِي (tantahibī) /tan.ta.hi.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# تُنْتَهَبِي (tuntahabī) /tun.ta.ha.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
